rationale: The bid-ask spread of ~$1.66 (113.6 bps) is more than 3x the 5-minute ATR of $0.50, meaning transaction costs alone would consume any realistic intraday move before the trade could become profitable. Although price is trading below both the 5-min VWAP ($147.89) and session VWAP ($152.38) with a mild downward drift in recent candles, the structure does not offer a mechanically favorable entry in either direction given the spread penalty. With no historical comparable setups and no actionable news catalyst, the risk-adjusted edge is insufficient to justify committing capital.
